authority.selection_basis: Preregistration froze deferred K values 0.02 and 0.10 but no representative cells; selection rule declared before execution.

scope.selection_rule: S3 at G1/G2/G3 plus S1/S2/S3 at G1, for both sleep and anesthesia

runtime.seed_policy: same primary stable_seed(12345, cell_id, encoded_window_index, repeat); K omitted so K shares seed list

integrity.parallel_equivalence: reused audited exact per-seed equivalence; max-Q equivalence; 4-worker speedup 3.796845x

interpretation.sleep: DS-C for selected condition-level/grain reversal; S3 G2 attenuates to near-zero at K=0.10, while S3 G1 remains positive and G3 negative at all K.
interpretation.anesthesia: DS-C for selected condition-level/grain reversal; DS-B for signal axis because S2 is positive at K=0.02 but negative at K=0.05 and 0.10.
interpretation.overall: K=0.05 alone is weakened as the explanation, but node-count/mean-degree/fragmentation, sparse signal, and implementation alternatives remain unresolved.

next_highest_information_control: Connectivity-/mean-degree-matched graph control before broader SRT-facing interpretation; if restricted to the original three routes, broader multi-animal/full-dataset replication is next.
